## Outcome

What problem does this solve, and what can a user or teammate do afterward?
Link the task/issue and name the human owner.

## Validation

List exact commands and results, plus manual checks or screenshots where useful.
State what was blocked or remains untested. Repository hygiene is not app validation.

## AI assistance and reused material

Name the tool and meaningful assistance, or say none. Describe human verification.
Link attribution/license details for reused code or assets where applicable.

## Risks and follow-up

Note limitations, setup changes, migrations, or required owner actions. Say none if none.

## Ready for human review

- [ ] The diff is focused and preserves other contributors' work.
- [ ] Relevant checks ran; results and limitations are accurately reported above.
- [ ] No secrets, private data, or generated build output are included.
- [ ] Documentation and AI disclosure reflect the actual change.
